conventions.commits: Conventional commits with scope (feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test); signed commits with PR references
conventions.testing: Unit tests in #[cfg(test)] mod tests blocks within language modules; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/; SemanticExtractor used for defuse site testing
conventions.linting: cargo clippy with deny-level lints: undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used; cargo fmt; cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; Option<T> for fallible operations; SAFETY comments required for unsafe blocks

patterns: Language modules in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/ export ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants
LanguageInfo struct registered in get_language_info() match arms with tree-sitter language binding and handler functions
Handler functions (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance) return Option<String> or Vec<String>
EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs maps file extensions to language identifiers; supported_languages() lists all available languages
Tree-sitter queries use capture groups (@function, @class, @method_name, @call, @read.usage, @write.assign, etc.)
Defuse queries distinguish write sites (local declarations, assignments) from read sites (identifier usage) and writeread sites (updates)
Test coverage includes element extraction, inheritance extraction, defuse site detection, and query validation
constraints: All languages unconditionally compiled; no feature gates for individual languages
Tree-sitter grammar node types and field names must match grammar source exactly
LanguageInfo struct requires name, language, element_query, call_query; optional fields may be None
Handler functions must safely extract text from source using byte ranges with bounds checks
Defuse queries must cover all declaration and assignment patterns in the target language
test_coverage: Existing language modules test: (1) element extraction via ELEMENT_QUERY (classes, functions, methods); (2) inheritance extraction via extract_inheritance handler; (3) defuse site detection via DEFUSE_QUERY for write/read/writeread patterns; (4) function name extraction; (5) receiver type detection for methods. Test patterns use tree-sitter Parser to parse sample code, run queries, and assert captured nodes match expected values.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; node types: function_declaration, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; fields: name (required), body (required), attributes (optional); inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) child nodes
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes (not fields) for inheritance; method_declaration appears inside class/interface/trait body's declaration_list; function_declaration is top-level; anonymous_class supported

library_findings.relevant_api: Query::new(), QueryCursor, Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte(), Node::kind(), Node::parent()
library_findings.notes: Core parsing and query API; all language handlers depend on this version

approaches.name: Approach 1: Minimal PHP support (CSS-like pattern)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only, no handlers for inheritance or defuse. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Covers function/method/class extraction but skips advanced analysis.
pros: Matches CSS pattern (minimal language with no handlers)
cons: Does not meet full feature parity with Java/Kotlin

approaches.name: Approach 2: Full PHP support with handlers and defuse (recommended)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, plus extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance handlers. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Add comprehensive test suite covering all dimensions.
pros: Aligns with project's stated goal of language support
cons: Requires understanding PHP grammar inheritance structure (base_clause/class_interface_clause)

approaches.name: Approach 3: Phased rollout (defuse-optional)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and extract_inheritance handler. Defer DEFUSE_QUERY and defuse-related handlers to a follow-up PR. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml.
pros: Delivers core analysis (functions, classes, inheritance) immediately
Defuse analysis can be added later without breaking changes
cons: Requires follow-up work to reach parity
Defuse_query field in LanguageInfo is marked Optional but pattern suggests it should be present for consistency

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP support with handlers and defuse). The issue explicitly requests PHP language support, and the project's pattern (Java, Kotlin, Python, Rust all have full handler suites and DEFUSE_QUERY) indicates that comprehensive support is the standard. The tree-sitter-php grammar is well-documented, and the inheritance structure (base_clause/class_interface_clause as child nodes) is straightforward to implement. Full support enables the project's core use case (semantic analysis) and avoids technical debt from incomplete implementations.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}

inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (common/define-grammar.js and php/src/node-types.json): class_declaration has a required 'name' field (type: name node) and a required 'body' field (type: declaration_list). Inheritance is NOT carried by fields but by child nodes: base_clause (child node matching 'extends' keyword followed by comma-separated names) and class_interface_clause (child node matching 'implements' keyword followed by comma-separated names). To extract inheritance: (1) iterate through class_declaration's children; (2) find base_clause child node and extract its name children as extends parents; (3) find class_interface_clause child node and extract its name children as implements parents.
